item.title: Japan Boosts Deep-Sea Mining Plan to Cut Rare-Earth Reliance
item.description: Japan is accelerating a decade-old plan to extract rare earths from the deep seabed, an ambitious initiative given extra impetus by the country’s drive to cut reliance on Chinese supply.

item.title: Indonesian Stocks Resume Selloff on Weaker Commodity Prices
item.description: Indonesian stocks resumed their selloff Monday, weighed by weaker commodity prices, complicating efforts by regulators to shore up confidence in Southeast Asia’s biggest equities market.

item.title: Copper Slump Deepens as Traders Wait for China Bulls to Step In
item.description: Copper extended its slump from a record high, as traders debated whether bullish investors in China might start buying again after a tumultuous few days that have rocked global metals markets.

item.title: Bank of England Set to Hold Rates With Eye on UK Jobs Downturn
item.description: The Bank of England is expected to keep interest rates on hold at 3.75% this week as policymakers weigh contradictory signs that the economy is both strengthening and losing jobs with unemployment at a near five-year high.
